skill.name: dependency-security
skill.description: Guides npm dependency audits, secure update workflows, SBOM generation, CI checks, and package trust review for JavaScript projects.
skill.summary: Audit npm dependencies, produce SBOMs, and add CI checks for supply-chain security.
skill.author: Doyajin174

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown fences, documentation links, and .npmrc hardening examples. I found no prompt injection, credential collection, or exfiltration intent, but the skill does recommend unpinned npx execution for several tools, which creates supply-chain risk.

remediation.issue: Unpinned npx commands can execute the latest registry package code.
remediation.suggestion: Pin tool versions, install trusted tools as devDependencies, or route commands through reviewed npm scripts.

remediation.issue: The skill allows Bash and presents commands that can change dependency files.
remediation.suggestion: Tell agents to request user confirmation before running fix, update, install, or commit commands.

remediation.issue: The npm audit fix --force example may introduce breaking dependency changes.
remediation.suggestion: Frame forced fixes as a last resort after backups, tests, and changelog review.

semantic_findings.description: The skill recommends several npx commands without version pins, including npm-check-updates, CycloneDX, npm-check, and license-checker. When executed, npx may download and run registry package code, which adds supply-chain risk to a security workflow.

content.user_title: Audit Dependency Security and Generate SBOMs
content.value_statement: Dependency updates can introduce vulnerable or untrusted packages. This skill guides audits, safer updates, SBOM creation, and CI checks.
actual_capabilities: Reviews package audit results and maps severity levels to remediation actions.
Guides npm audit, npm outdated, and dependency update workflows.
Explains how to generate CycloneDX or SPDX SBOM artifacts.
Provides CI examples for audit checks and SBOM upload steps.
Documents .npmrc hardening settings for npm projects.
Lists package trust checks for maintenance, licenses, and deprecation status.
limitations: Focused mainly on npm and JavaScript package workflows.
Does not replace a full SCA platform or legal license review.
Some examples require shell access and user approval before execution.
External tool results depend on current registry and vulnerability database data.

use_cases.title: Review a New Package
use_cases.description: Check package reputation, maintenance, license fit, and audit results before adding it to a project.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Security Review
use_cases.description: Create an audit checklist, update dependencies, and produce an SBOM for review evidence.

use_cases.title: Add CI Dependency Gates
use_cases.description: Add pipeline steps that run npm audit, preserve lockfiles, and publish SBOM artifacts.

prompt_templates.title: Check My Dependencies
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner audit of an npm project
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this npm project for dependency security. Summarize audit risks, outdated packages, and safe next steps before running any commands.

prompt_templates.title: Assess a New Package
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate whether I should add this npm package. Check maintenance, downloads, license compatibility, known vulnerabilities, and safer alternatives.

prompt_templates.title: Create an SBOM Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an SBOM generation workflow for this repository. Include tool choice, output format, storage location, and CI artifact handling.

prompt_templates.title: Harden CI Dependency Controls
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a CI dependency security plan with audit thresholds, lockfile enforcement, update cadence, SBOM generation, and manual approval gates.

output_examples.input: Review a project that has high npm audit findings and stale dependencies.
output: Prioritized high and critical vulnerabilities for immediate remediation.
Separated patch, minor, and major updates into safer review groups.
Recommended test and lockfile checks before committing dependency changes.

output_examples.input: Add dependency checks to a GitHub Actions workflow.
output: A CI plan that installs with npm ci and runs audit gates.
An SBOM generation step with artifact retention guidance.
Notes about command approval and version-pinned security tools.

output_examples.input: Evaluate whether to use a new npm package.
output: A package trust checklist covering maintenance, license, and vulnerability status.
Decision guidance for accepting, delaying, or replacing the dependency.

best_practices: Review audit output before applying automatic dependency fixes.
Commit lockfiles and use deterministic installs in CI.
Pin security tooling versions when running external package commands.
anti_patterns: Running forced dependency fixes without tests or changelog review.
Using unpinned npx tools in automated security pipelines.
Ignoring moderate vulnerabilities because they are not currently blocking.

faq.question: Does this skill run security tools automatically?
faq.answer: It provides workflows and command examples. Shell commands should require user approval before execution.

faq.question: Which ecosystem does it support best?
faq.answer: It supports npm and JavaScript projects best. Other ecosystems may need different commands and tools.

faq.question: Can it generate an SBOM?
faq.answer: It explains how to generate CycloneDX or SPDX SBOM files using common npm-compatible tools.

faq.question: Does it replace a vulnerability scanner?
faq.answer: No. It organizes scanner usage and review steps, but the results come from external tools and databases.

faq.question: How should teams handle audit fix commands?
faq.answer: Run them in a branch, inspect changes, run tests, and avoid forced fixes unless there is a clear reason.

faq.question: Is this usable with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The content is compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows for repository review.
